title: ComposterHUD
description: A small HUD shows any composter's exact fill level (0-8) and tells you the moment it's ready to harvest bone meal.
body:
**ComposterHUD** is a clean info layer for farmers. Point your crosshair at any **composter** and a small readout appears in the **top-left** of your screen.

### What it shows
- **Fill level** - the exact `0-8` compost height, so you know how close it is to producing bone meal.
- **Ready to harvest** - a clear **Ready: bone meal** note the moment the composter hits level 8 and a layer of bone meal is sitting on top.

### Why
Vanilla only hints at a composter's state through a subtle texture change inside the block, which is hard to read at a glance, especially across a wall of composters on a farm. ComposterHUD puts the precise fill number on screen so you can see which composters still need feeding and which are ready to empty.

### Controls
- **C** - toggle the readout on/off. An action-bar message confirms the state.

### Compatibility
**Minecraft 1.21.8, 1.21.9, 1.21.10, 1.21.11** - Fabric Loader 0.16+. One JAR covers all four. Pure client-side: install on your client only, works on any Fabric server, fully vanilla-compatible. Requires Fabric API.
